title: Apple and BBQ Sauce Baby Back Ribs
description: This apple and BBQ sauce baby back ribs recipe marinates ribs in a mixture of applesauce, barbecue sauce, salt, black pepper, cayenne pepper, and garlic.
ingredients: salt and black pepper to taste

steps.text: Combine barbecue sauce and applesauce in a bowl. Place ribs on a large sheet of heavy duty aluminum foil; rub salt, black pepper, cayenne pepper, and garlic powder on all sides ribs. Pour barbecue sauce mixture over ribs to coat; seal ribs in foil. Marinate in the refrigerator 8 hours to overnight.
Preheat an outdoor grill for high heat and lightly oil the grate.

Place ribs in foil on grill grate; cook on the preheated grill 1 hour. Remove ribs from foil; place directly on the grate. Continue cooking until ribs are done, about 30 minutes more, basting frequently with sauce.
